customer_message: Hi, I bought a sealed USB-C charger from NovaCart 5 days ago and changed my mind. Can I return it?
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. Customers pay return shipping for change-of-mind returns.
candidate_reply: Yes. Since the charger is unopened and within 14 days of delivery, you can request a return authorization for a refund or store credit. Because this is a change-of-mind return, return shipping is your responsibility.

customer_message: My unopened Bluetooth speaker was delivered 18 days ago. I never used it. Can I still get a refund?
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. Opened non-defective products are not eligible for a change-of-mind refund.
candidate_reply: That should be fine because it is still unopened. Send it back with the return label and we will process a full refund when it arrives.

customer_message: I opened a pair of earbuds yesterday and they work, but I do not like the fit. Can I return them for my money back?
policy: Opened non-defective products are not eligible for a change-of-mind refund. Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery.
candidate_reply: I understand the fit is not what you expected, but opened non-defective earbuds are not eligible for a change-of-mind refund under NovaCart policy.

customer_message: The charging brick I bought 20 days ago stopped working today. I want either a refund or a replacement. What are my options?
policy: Products that become defective within 30 calendar days of delivery may qualify for a free replacement or full refund after review. NovaCart provides prepaid return shipping for qualifying defective items.
candidate_reply: Because the charger became defective within 30 days, we can review it for a free replacement or a full refund. If it qualifies, NovaCart will provide prepaid return shipping.

customer_message: I ordered a sealed wireless mouse but found one cheaper elsewhere. It arrived a week ago. Do I have to pay return shipping?
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. Customers pay return shipping for change-of-mind returns.
candidate_reply: You can return the sealed mouse within the 14-day window, and we will send you a prepaid return label so you do not have to pay anything to ship it back.

customer_message: Tracking says NovaCart received my returned monitor yesterday. When should I see the refund?
policy: Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the returned item is received and inspected. Refund processing normally takes 5 to 7 business days after receipt and inspection.
candidate_reply: Once the monitor is received and inspected, the refund is issued to the original payment method. It normally takes 5 to 7 business days after that step.

customer_message: I got a return authorization for an unopened tablet, but I have not mailed it yet. Can you refund me now so I can buy something else?
policy: Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the returned item is received and inspected. Customers must request a return authorization before sending an item back.
candidate_reply: Yes, once a return authorization exists we can start the refund immediately. Just make sure you send the tablet later so the warehouse can close the case.

customer_message: I bought a sealed smart plug 10 days ago as a gift, but the person already has one. I would rather get store credit than a card refund.
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. Customers pay return shipping for change-of-mind returns.
candidate_reply: Store credit is an option for an unopened item within 14 days. You can request a return authorization, and return shipping would be your responsibility because this is a change-of-mind return.

customer_message: The laptop is not defective, but I opened the box and decided I want a different brand. It was delivered 3 days ago. Refund possible?
policy: Opened non-defective products are not eligible for a change-of-mind refund. Direct exchanges for change-of-mind purchases are not offered.
candidate_reply: No problem. Since it is only been 3 days, you can send the laptop back for a full refund and order the other brand whenever you are ready.

customer_message: I received a sealed speaker and an opened HDMI cable in the same order 12 days ago. I changed my mind on both. Can both be returned?
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. Opened non-defective products are not eligible for a change-of-mind refund. Customers pay return shipping for change-of-mind returns.
candidate_reply: The sealed speaker is still eligible for a return because it is within 14 days. Start a return authorization and choose refund or store credit.

customer_message: If I return an unopened keyboard because I do not need it anymore, will NovaCart refund the original shipping fee too?
policy: Original shipping fees are refunded only when the return is caused by a NovaCart error, damaged item, defective item, or incorrect item. Customers pay return shipping for change-of-mind returns.
candidate_reply: For a change-of-mind return, NovaCart refunds the eligible product price but not the original shipping fee. You would also pay the return shipping.

customer_message: My headphones stopped charging 35 days after delivery. Can I return them for a full refund?
policy: Products that become defective within 30 calendar days of delivery may qualify for a free replacement or full refund after review. Defects reported more than 30 days after delivery are handled through warranty review, not the standard return refund process.
candidate_reply: Yes. Any defective electronics can be refunded at any time during the first year, so we can approve a full refund for the headphones.

customer_message: I got a fitness tracker as a gift. It is unopened, delivered 9 days ago, and I have the order number. Can I get store credit?
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. Refunds are issued to the original payment method unless store credit is selected for an eligible return.
candidate_reply: Yes, an unopened item delivered 9 days ago is within the return window. With the order number, you can request store credit instead of sending money back to the purchaser's payment method.

customer_message: The box for my webcam arrived dented, but the webcam works and nothing is missing. Can I get a partial refund for the ugly packaging?
policy: NovaCart does not issue partial refunds for damaged packaging when the product itself works and all accessories are present. Damaged packaging alone does not qualify for a refund or replacement.
candidate_reply: We can offer a small partial refund for packaging damage even if the webcam works, because the item did not arrive in perfect condition.

customer_message: I bought the wrong monitor size. It is unopened and came 6 days ago. Can NovaCart exchange it directly for the larger one?
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. Direct exchanges for change-of-mind purchases are not offered; customers may return an eligible unopened item and place a new order.
candidate_reply: NovaCart does not do direct exchanges for a change-of-mind purchase. You can return the unopened monitor within 14 days for a refund or store credit, then place a new order for the larger size.

customer_message: The tablet I opened yesterday keeps shutting down. It was delivered 6 days ago. I would prefer a refund, not another tablet.
policy: Products that become defective within 30 calendar days of delivery may qualify for a free replacement or full refund after review. NovaCart provides prepaid return shipping for qualifying defective items.
candidate_reply: Since the tablet appears defective and was delivered 6 days ago, it can be reviewed for a refund or replacement. If approved, NovaCart provides prepaid return shipping.

customer_message: I bought a router last week and now it is on sale for $20 less. Can you refund the difference instead of making me return it?
policy: Price adjustments are not applied after checkout. Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit.
candidate_reply: We do not apply price adjustments after checkout. If the router is unopened and still within 14 days of delivery, you may request an eligible return instead.

customer_message: The smartwatch is unopened, but I threw away the shipping carton. The product box is still sealed. It came 8 days ago. Is that a problem?
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. Customers must request a return authorization before sending an item back.
candidate_reply: The sealed product may still be returnable within the 14-day window, but you should request a return authorization before sending it. Use secure packaging for the shipment back.

customer_message: I mailed back an unopened camera without asking for a return authorization first. Will I still get refunded?
policy: Customers must request a return authorization before sending an item back. Refunds are issued after the returned item is received and inspected.
candidate_reply: Returns should have a return authorization before shipment. Please contact support with the tracking number so they can try to match the package and review it after inspection.

customer_message: I accidentally ordered two laptop stands. Both arrived yesterday, one is unopened. I only want to keep one.
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. Customers pay return shipping for change-of-mind returns.
candidate_reply: Return the extra unopened stand if you want. You have 14 days, and return shipping is on you because NovaCart did not make an error.

customer_message: My refund was approved, but the credit card I used is closed. Can NovaCart send the money to my new debit card?
policy: Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the returned item is received and inspected. If the original payment method is unavailable, verified customers may receive store credit instead.
candidate_reply: We can send the refund to any new card you provide. Just send the new debit card details and we will redirect the refund there.

customer_message: Today is exactly 14 days since my sealed headphones were delivered. Am I too late to return them?
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. The 14th calendar day after delivery is still inside the return window.
candidate_reply: You are already outside the return period once day 14 starts, so NovaCart cannot accept the headphones anymore.

customer_message: I opened a non-defective smartwatch and decided I hate the color. It arrived two days ago. Can I return it if I pay a restocking fee?
policy: Opened non-defective products are not eligible for a change-of-mind refund. Direct exchanges for change-of-mind purchases are not offered.
candidate_reply: Yes, you can return opened items within 14 days if you agree to a restocking fee. We will deduct that fee from the refund.

customer_message: My unopened printer arrived 15 days ago. I missed the return deadline by one day. Can someone make an exception?
policy: Unopened products may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or store credit. Support may escalate requests for policy exceptions but should not promise an exception, refund, replacement, or compensation that policy does not allow.
candidate_reply: I can ask a human support specialist to review the request, but I cannot promise an exception because the standard return window is 14 days.

customer_message: NovaCart received my returned dock 10 business days ago and the refund still is not on my card. What now?
policy: Refund processing normally takes 5 to 7 business days after the returned item is received and inspected. If a refund has not posted after 7 business days from receipt and inspection, support should escalate the case to billing support.
candidate_reply: That is longer than the normal 5 to 7 business-day processing time after receipt and inspection. Support should escalate the refund case to billing support for review.

customer_message: I ordered a black wireless keyboard and got a white one today. Can you send the black keyboard?
policy: Incorrect products may be exchanged for the correct product or refunded within 30 calendar days of delivery. NovaCart provides a prepaid return label for incorrect products.
candidate_reply: Yes. Since you received the wrong color, NovaCart can exchange it for the correct black keyboard within 30 days and provide a prepaid return label for the white one.

customer_message: The laptop model delivered is the 8 GB version, but I ordered the 16 GB version. It arrived 20 days ago.
policy: Incorrect products may be exchanged for the correct product or refunded within 30 calendar days of delivery. NovaCart provides a prepaid return label for incorrect products.
candidate_reply: You can exchange it because it is within 30 days, but you will need to pay return shipping before NovaCart sends the correct model.

customer_message: I just noticed my monitor is the wrong model, but it was delivered 45 days ago. I never opened it. Can I exchange it?
policy: Incorrect products may be exchanged for the correct product or refunded within 30 calendar days of delivery. Support may escalate requests for policy exceptions but should not promise an exception.
candidate_reply: The standard wrong-item window is 30 days, so I cannot promise an exchange at 45 days. Support can escalate the case for review if you want to ask for an exception.

customer_message: The tablet screen was cracked when I opened the box this morning. Delivery was today. I need help.
policy: Damaged-on-arrival items must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. Damaged-on-arrival items reported within 7 days qualify for a free replacement or a full refund. NovaCart may request photos or a return inspection.
candidate_reply: I am sorry the tablet arrived cracked. Because you reported it the day it was delivered, it qualifies for damaged-on-arrival review, and you may choose a free replacement or a full refund after the required photos or inspection.

customer_message: My camera lens arrived cracked, but I was traveling and did not open the package until 10 days after delivery. Can I still get a free replacement?
policy: Damaged-on-arrival items must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. Support may escalate requests for policy exceptions but should not promise an exception, refund, replacement, or compensation that policy does not allow.
candidate_reply: Yes, cracked items always qualify for a free replacement no matter when you report them. We can send a replacement right away.

customer_message: The action camera arrived today without the charging cable listed in the box contents. Can you send just the cable?
policy: Missing items or missing accessories must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. For a missing accessory, NovaCart may ship the missing accessory or offer an appropriate refund for that accessory.
candidate_reply: Since the missing cable was reported on the delivery day, NovaCart can review the claim and either send the missing cable or offer an appropriate accessory refund.

customer_message: The outside box for my router was crushed, but the router powers on and all parts are here. Can I get a discount?
policy: Damaged packaging alone does not qualify for a refund or replacement if the product works and all accessories are present. NovaCart does not issue partial refunds for damaged packaging when the product itself works.
candidate_reply: We can apply a 20 percent refund for the crushed box. You can keep the router and do not need to return anything.

customer_message: I ordered two gaming headsets. One arrived with a broken microphone and the other is fine. Do I have to return both?
policy: Damaged-on-arrival items reported within 7 days qualify for a free replacement or a full refund. NovaCart may request photos or a return inspection. Replacement claims should address the affected item.
candidate_reply: Please return both headsets together so the warehouse can process the damaged item. After both are back, we can decide whether to replace the broken one.

customer_message: NovaCart sent the wrong size tablet case. It came yesterday and I need the one that fits the 11-inch model.
policy: Incorrect products may be exchanged for the correct product or refunded within 30 calendar days of delivery. NovaCart provides a prepaid return label for incorrect products.
candidate_reply: Because the wrong case was delivered yesterday, you are within the 30-day wrong-item window. NovaCart can provide a prepaid label and exchange it for the correct 11-inch case.

customer_message: My monitor arrived with a cracked corner. I reported it within an hour. Can you overnight the replacement?
policy: Damaged-on-arrival items reported within 7 days qualify for a free replacement or a full refund. Replacement shipping uses standard shipping. Expedited replacement shipping is not guaranteed.
candidate_reply: You qualify for a replacement or refund, and because it arrived cracked we will guarantee free overnight shipping for the replacement.

customer_message: The remote for my streaming box is missing. I noticed it 9 days after delivery because I was setting it up today.
policy: Missing items or missing accessories must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. Support may escalate requests for policy exceptions but should not promise an exception.
candidate_reply: Missing accessories have to be reported within 7 days. Since this was noticed after 9 days, I cannot promise a replacement remote, but support can review the case if you want to escalate it.

customer_message: I ordered a new pair of noise-canceling headphones, but the box says refurbished. Delivery was 12 days ago.
policy: Incorrect products may be exchanged for the correct product or refunded within 30 calendar days of delivery. NovaCart provides a prepaid return label for incorrect products.
candidate_reply: If you ordered a new product and received a refurbished one, that is an incorrect product issue. It is within 30 days, so NovaCart can provide a prepaid return label and exchange or refund it.

customer_message: The smartwatch face has a deep scratch out of the box. I reported it 2 days after delivery and can send photos.
policy: Damaged-on-arrival items must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. NovaCart may request photos or a return inspection. Damaged-on-arrival items reported within 7 days qualify for a free replacement or full refund.
candidate_reply: Scratches are cosmetic, so they are never covered. You can keep using the watch, but NovaCart will not replace it.

customer_message: My portable speaker started making a loud crackling sound 25 days after delivery. It has not been dropped.
policy: Products that become defective within 30 calendar days of delivery may qualify for a free replacement or full refund after review. NovaCart provides prepaid return shipping for qualifying defective items.
candidate_reply: Since the speaker appears defective within 30 days and you report no accidental damage, it can be reviewed for a free replacement or full refund with prepaid return shipping if approved.

customer_message: The same speaker stopped charging after 4 months. Can NovaCart refund me?
policy: Defects reported more than 30 days after delivery are handled through warranty review, not the standard return refund process. Warranty covers manufacturer defects for one year but does not automatically provide a refund.
candidate_reply: Yes, any defect within the first year is eligible for a full refund to your original payment method.

customer_message: You shipped me the wrong webcam and I do not want a replacement anymore. It arrived 5 days ago. Can I just get a refund?
policy: Incorrect products may be exchanged for the correct product or refunded within 30 calendar days of delivery. NovaCart provides a prepaid return label for incorrect products.
candidate_reply: Yes. Because the wrong webcam arrived 5 days ago, you may choose a refund instead of an exchange, and NovaCart should provide a prepaid return label.

customer_message: The smart home bundle arrived today, but the motion sensor listed in the bundle is not in the box.
policy: Missing items or missing accessories must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. For a missing paid item in an order, NovaCart may ship the missing item or refund that item after review.
candidate_reply: Since you reported the missing motion sensor on delivery day, NovaCart can review it and either ship the missing sensor or refund that part of the bundle as appropriate.

customer_message: Support approved my damaged keyboard replacement. Do you ship the replacement after I mail the broken one or only after it reaches your warehouse?
policy: Replacement items normally ship after the carrier shows the customer return has its first scan. Replacement shipping uses standard shipping.
candidate_reply: The replacement only ships after the damaged keyboard is fully delivered to the warehouse and inspected, so the first carrier scan will not be enough.

customer_message: My new desktop case has a visible dent on the front panel. It still works, but I reported it the day after delivery. Does that count as damage?
policy: Damaged-on-arrival items must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. Damaged-on-arrival items reported within 7 days qualify for a free replacement or a full refund. NovaCart may request photos or a return inspection.
candidate_reply: Yes, visible product damage reported the day after delivery can be reviewed as damaged-on-arrival. NovaCart may ask for photos or inspection before offering a replacement or refund.

customer_message: I dropped my e-reader a month after buying it and cracked the screen. Is that covered as damaged-on-arrival?
policy: Accidental damage caused after delivery is not covered as damaged-on-arrival or warranty damage. Damaged-on-arrival items must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery.
candidate_reply: No. Damage from dropping the e-reader after delivery is accidental damage, not damaged-on-arrival coverage.

customer_message: I received the wrong phone case and used it for three weeks before realizing it blocks the camera. It is still within 30 days. Can I exchange it?
policy: Incorrect products may be exchanged for the correct product or refunded within 30 calendar days of delivery. NovaCart provides a prepaid return label for incorrect products.
candidate_reply: Because you received the wrong case and are still within 30 days, NovaCart can review it as an incorrect product and provide a prepaid return label if it is accepted for exchange or refund.

customer_message: The stylus that was supposed to come with my drawing tablet is missing. Delivery was 6 days ago.
policy: Missing items or missing accessories must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. For a missing accessory, NovaCart may ship the missing accessory or offer an appropriate refund for that accessory.
candidate_reply: This is within the 7-day missing accessory window. NovaCart can review the order and send the stylus or offer an appropriate accessory refund.

customer_message: NovaCart sent me an extra webcam I did not order. Am I going to be charged if I keep it on my desk until you answer?
policy: If NovaCart sends an unordered extra item, support should arrange a prepaid return label and should not charge the customer for NovaCart's mistake.
candidate_reply: If you keep the extra webcam for more than 7 days, NovaCart will charge your card automatically. You should mail it back at your own cost.

customer_message: The drone box was crushed and the drone powers on, but the camera keeps disconnecting. I reported this 5 days after delivery.
policy: Damaged-on-arrival items must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. Damaged-on-arrival items reported within 7 days qualify for a free replacement or a full refund after review. Damaged packaging alone does not qualify if the product works, but product malfunction can be reviewed.
candidate_reply: Because the drone itself is malfunctioning and you reported it within 7 days, NovaCart can review it as damaged-on-arrival or defective, not just packaging damage.

customer_message: My printer arrived damaged. I want a replacement and a $50 credit for the hassle. I reported it the same day.
policy: Damaged-on-arrival items reported within 7 days qualify for a free replacement or a full refund. Support should not promise compensation that the policy does not allow.
candidate_reply: You can choose a free replacement or a full refund for the damaged printer, but I cannot promise an extra $50 credit under the policy.

customer_message: My package is one day late, but tracking updated this morning and says it is in transit. Can I get a refund now?
policy: Standard delivery estimates are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates unless a guaranteed service is explicitly purchased. Refunds or replacements for potentially lost shipments are not issued until the carrier investigation is completed.
candidate_reply: A refund is not available just because the package is one day past the estimate while tracking is still updating. Please continue watching the tracking, and support can help if it becomes stalled long enough for investigation.

customer_message: Tracking has not moved for four days after the estimated delivery date. I still want the laptop, but I need to know what happens next.
policy: If tracking has not updated for at least 72 hours after the estimated delivery date, support may open a carrier investigation. Refunds or replacements for potentially lost shipments are not issued until the carrier investigation is completed.
candidate_reply: Because tracking has been stalled for more than 72 hours after the estimated delivery date, support can open a carrier investigation. A replacement or refund would wait until that investigation is completed unless the carrier confirms it is lost sooner.

customer_message: My order is 2 days past the delivery estimate and tracking has been frozen for 48 hours. Please refund it.
policy: If tracking has not updated for at least 72 hours after the estimated delivery date, support may open a carrier investigation. Refunds or replacements for potentially lost shipments are not issued until the carrier investigation is completed.
candidate_reply: Since tracking has already stopped, we can refund the order right away and skip the carrier investigation.

customer_message: Tracking says delivered this afternoon, but I do not see the box. What should I do before opening a claim?
policy: For packages marked delivered but not found, customers should check the delivery location, household members, neighbors, mailroom, and building office. Support may open a carrier trace after 24 hours from the delivery scan.
candidate_reply: Please check the delivery spot, household members, neighbors, mailroom, or building office first. If it still is not found 24 hours after the delivery scan, support can open a carrier trace.

customer_message: My package was marked delivered three days ago. I checked with the front desk and neighbors and nobody has it.
policy: For a delivered-not-found package, support may open a carrier trace after 24 hours from the delivery scan. Refunds or replacements are not issued until the carrier investigation is completed unless the carrier confirms the shipment is lost.
candidate_reply: Because more than 24 hours have passed and you already checked nearby locations, support can open a carrier trace. Refunds or replacements wait for the trace result unless the carrier confirms it is lost.

customer_message: A carrier investigation is already open for my missing monitor. It has been two business days. Can you refund me today?
policy: Carrier investigations may take up to 7 business days. Refunds or replacements for potentially lost shipments are not issued until the carrier investigation is completed, unless the carrier has already confirmed the shipment is lost.
candidate_reply: Two business days is long enough. We can close the investigation early and refund the monitor today.

customer_message: The carrier just confirmed my tablet shipment is lost. Do I have to keep waiting for NovaCart to investigate too?
policy: If the carrier confirms a shipment is lost, NovaCart may offer a replacement or refund. Refunds or replacements are not issued until the carrier investigation is completed unless the carrier has already confirmed the shipment is lost.
candidate_reply: No additional wait should be needed if the carrier has confirmed the shipment is lost. NovaCart may offer a replacement or refund.

customer_message: I accidentally used my old apartment address and the order has already shipped. Can NovaCart send another one free?
policy: If the customer entered an incorrect shipping address and the order has shipped, NovaCart does not provide a free replacement or refund. If the order is returned to NovaCart, NovaCart may refund the product price minus shipping fees or reship at the customer's shipping cost.
candidate_reply: Because the order shipped to the address entered at checkout, NovaCart cannot send a free replacement. If the package comes back to NovaCart, support can review a product-price refund minus shipping or reship it at your shipping cost.

customer_message: The order has not shipped yet and I typed the wrong ZIP code. Can the address be fixed?
policy: Address changes can only be made before an order ships. Shipping address changes may be made only before an order is packed or shipped.
candidate_reply: If the order has not been packed or shipped, support may be able to correct the ZIP code. Once it ships, the address cannot be changed by NovaCart.

customer_message: I paid for expedited shipping, the package arrived within the promised window, but I decided I do not need the item. Can I get the shipping fee back?
policy: Expedited shipping fees are not refunded after carrier acceptance unless NovaCart caused the delay or shipped the order incorrectly. Original shipping fees are refunded only when the return is caused by a NovaCart error, damaged item, defective item, or incorrect item.
candidate_reply: The expedited shipping fee is not refundable in this situation because the carrier accepted and delivered it on time, and the return is not due to a NovaCart error.

customer_message: I ordered three items. Two arrived, and the third has a separate tracking number that still says arriving tomorrow. Can you refund the missing one today?
policy: Orders may ship in multiple packages. An item is not considered missing if its separate tracking number is still within the delivery estimate.
candidate_reply: Yes, if it was not in the first box, it counts as missing. NovaCart can refund that item today.

customer_message: My tracking has said label created for 24 hours, but the estimated delivery date is still three days away. Is it lost?
policy: If tracking has not updated for at least 72 hours after the estimated delivery date, support may open a carrier investigation. Standard delivery estimates are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates unless explicitly purchased.
candidate_reply: It is too early to treat the package as lost. The investigation window applies after tracking is stalled for at least 72 hours past the estimated delivery date.

customer_message: The carrier returned my headphones to NovaCart because of a routing error. I entered the right address. What can support do?
policy: Standard shipping fees are refunded when NovaCart caused the problem or canceled the order. If NovaCart or the carrier caused the shipping problem, support may arrange reshipment or refund after review.
candidate_reply: Since this was not caused by an incorrect address you entered, support can review the return-to-sender scan and arrange a reshipment or refund as appropriate.

customer_message: My package was returned to sender because I forgot my apartment number. Can I get a full refund including shipping?
policy: If the customer entered an incorrect shipping address and the order has shipped, NovaCart does not provide a free replacement or refund. If the order is returned to NovaCart, NovaCart may refund the product price minus shipping fees or reship at the customer's shipping cost.
candidate_reply: Yes, once it returns to NovaCart we will refund the product and all shipping fees because the package did not reach you.

customer_message: My replacement keyboard is two days later than expected. Can you send another one overnight for free?
policy: Replacement shipping uses standard shipping. Expedited replacement shipping is not guaranteed. Standard delivery estimates are estimates unless a guaranteed service is explicitly purchased.
candidate_reply: NovaCart guarantees overnight shipping for delayed replacements, so we can send another keyboard right away at no cost.

customer_message: The carrier says weather may delay my delivery, but the estimated date is still tomorrow. Can NovaCart refund shipping now?
policy: Standard delivery estimates are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates unless a guaranteed service is explicitly purchased. Standard shipping fees are refunded only when NovaCart caused the problem or canceled the order.
candidate_reply: A weather notice before the estimated date does not qualify for an immediate shipping refund. Support can review it if the shipment later meets the delay or investigation rules.

customer_message: My package shows delivered to the mailroom 30 hours ago. The building office checked and says it is not there.
policy: For packages marked delivered but not found, customers should check the delivery location, household members, neighbors, mailroom, and building office. Support may open a carrier trace after 24 hours from the delivery scan.
candidate_reply: You have checked the mailroom and more than 24 hours have passed, so support can open a carrier trace for the delivered-not-found package.

customer_message: Box A arrived, but Box B has been stuck for 4 days after the estimated delivery date. The missing box has the monitor stand.
policy: Orders may ship in multiple packages. If tracking has not updated for at least 72 hours after the estimated delivery date, support may open a carrier investigation for the affected package.
candidate_reply: Since Box B has separate tracking and has been stalled for more than 72 hours after its estimated date, support can open a carrier investigation for that package.

customer_message: The courier left my package with a neighbor I do not know. Tracking says delivered yesterday, and the neighbor will not answer.
policy: For packages marked delivered but not found, customers should check the delivery location, household members, neighbors, mailroom, and building office. Support may open a carrier trace after 24 hours from the delivery scan.
candidate_reply: Because the scan was yesterday and the package still has not been recovered after checking the neighbor, support can open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement depends on the trace result.

customer_message: My order is late, but tracking updated late last night in another city. Should support open a lost-package claim?
policy: If tracking has not updated for at least 72 hours after the estimated delivery date, support may open a carrier investigation. Standard delivery estimates are estimates unless a guaranteed service is explicitly purchased.
candidate_reply: Since tracking updated last night, it is not stalled for 72 hours. A lost-package investigation would not be opened yet.

customer_message: Standard shipping was one day late. I still got the item. Can I get the standard shipping fee refunded?
policy: Standard delivery estimates are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates unless a guaranteed service is explicitly purchased. Standard shipping fees are refunded only when NovaCart caused the problem or canceled the order.
candidate_reply: A one-day delay on standard shipping does not automatically qualify for a shipping refund unless NovaCart caused the problem or canceled the order.

customer_message: Tracking has not updated for 72 hours, but the estimated delivery date is tomorrow. Can we start the carrier investigation today?
policy: If tracking has not updated for at least 72 hours after the estimated delivery date, support may open a carrier investigation.
candidate_reply: Yes, 72 hours without tracking is enough by itself. We can start the investigation now even though the estimated delivery date has not passed.

customer_message: The carrier investigation for my lost camera has had no update for 8 business days. Is there finally a refund option?
policy: Carrier investigations may take up to 7 business days. If an investigation has no resolution after 7 business days, NovaCart may offer a replacement or refund.
candidate_reply: Yes. Since the investigation has gone past 7 business days without resolution, NovaCart may offer a replacement or refund.

customer_message: My shipment might be lost and the investigation started yesterday. I need a replacement sent before the weekend.
policy: Refunds or replacements for potentially lost shipments are not issued until the carrier investigation is completed, unless the carrier has already confirmed the shipment is lost. Carrier investigations may take up to 7 business days.
candidate_reply: I know the timing is frustrating, but NovaCart does not issue a replacement while the carrier investigation is still pending unless the carrier confirms the shipment is lost.

customer_message: NovaCart confirmation shows my correct address, but the package was routed to a different ZIP and returned. Support blamed me without checking.
policy: Standard shipping fees are refunded when NovaCart caused the problem or canceled the order. Possible shipping errors by NovaCart or the carrier should be reviewed before denying help.
candidate_reply: If the confirmation shows the correct address, support should review the routing issue instead of assuming customer error. If NovaCart or the carrier caused the problem, reshipment or refund may be appropriate after review.

customer_message: Please cancel my NovaCare Plus monthly subscription. Will I still have access until the billing period ends?
policy: NovaCare Plus subscriptions may be canceled at any time. Cancellation stops future renewals. Subscription access remains active until the end of the current paid billing period.
candidate_reply: Yes. Canceling stops future renewals, and your NovaCare Plus access remains active until the end of the current paid billing period.

customer_message: My NovaCare Plus renewal posted yesterday and I have not used any benefits since then. Can I cancel and get the renewal refunded?
policy: Subscription renewal refunds are available only when cancellation is requested within 48 hours of renewal and no member benefits were used after renewal. Cancellation stops future renewals.
candidate_reply: Because the renewal was yesterday and you have not used benefits since then, the renewal can be reviewed for a refund when you cancel.

customer_message: I forgot to cancel NovaCare Plus. It renewed 5 days ago, and I used the member shipping discount yesterday. Can you refund it anyway?
policy: Subscription renewal refunds are available only when cancellation is requested within 48 hours of renewal and no member benefits were used after renewal. NovaCart does not provide prorated subscription refunds after 48 hours or after member benefits are used.
candidate_reply: We can refund the renewal as a courtesy and leave the shipping discount in place. You will keep access until the refund finishes.

customer_message: I paid for annual NovaCare Plus in January and want to cancel halfway through the year. Do I get six months back?
policy: NovaCare Plus subscriptions may be canceled at any time. NovaCart does not provide prorated subscription refunds after 48 hours or after member benefits are used. Access remains active until the end of the current paid billing period.
candidate_reply: You can cancel to stop the next renewal, but NovaCart does not provide a prorated refund halfway through the paid period. Access remains active until the annual period ends.

customer_message: My card shows two posted charges for the same order number, same amount, same day. Can one be reversed?
policy: Duplicate posted charges for the same order or subscription may be refunded after verification. Pending authorizations are not posted charges.
candidate_reply: If both are posted duplicate charges for the same order, support can verify the billing records and refund the duplicate charge if confirmed.

customer_message: I see one posted charge and one pending charge for my tablet order. It looks like NovaCart charged me twice.
policy: Pending authorizations are not posted charges and usually drop within 3 to 5 business days. Duplicate posted charges may be refunded after verification.
candidate_reply: We should refund both amounts immediately to be safe, because a pending authorization is the same as a posted duplicate charge.

customer_message: My payment failed for a laptop order, but I need it shipped today. Can NovaCart send it while I fix the card later?
policy: Failed payments mean the order is not placed or the subscription may pause until payment succeeds. NovaCart does not ship an order until payment succeeds.
candidate_reply: NovaCart cannot ship the laptop until payment succeeds. Please update or retry the payment method first.

customer_message: My NovaCare Plus renewal failed. If I update my card today, will the plan start again?
policy: Failed payments mean the subscription may pause until payment succeeds. Updating a payment method applies to future charges and payment retries.
candidate_reply: Updating the card lets NovaCart retry the payment. Once payment succeeds, the subscription can resume.

customer_message: My free trial turned into a paid NovaCare Plus subscription this morning. I forgot to cancel, but I have not used it today.
policy: Subscription renewal refunds are available only when cancellation is requested within 48 hours of renewal and no member benefits were used after renewal. Cancellation stops future renewals.
candidate_reply: Trial conversions are never refundable, even if you cancel the same day and did not use any benefits.

customer_message: Can you move my NovaCare Plus billing date from the 2nd to the 15th? My payment is not past due.
policy: Billing-date changes may be reviewed by support for active accounts that are not past due. Updating a payment method applies to future charges and payment retries.
candidate_reply: Support can review a billing-date change because your account is active and not past due, but any approved change would apply to future billing.

customer_message: I was renewed 24 hours ago, but I used the NovaCare express support benefit this morning. Can I still get the renewal refunded?
policy: Subscription renewal refunds are available only when cancellation is requested within 48 hours of renewal and no member benefits were used after renewal. NovaCart does not provide refunds after member benefits are used.
candidate_reply: Because the request is within 48 hours, the renewal is refundable. Using express support does not affect the refund.

customer_message: I have a cancellation confirmation from last week, but NovaCart charged me for NovaCare Plus today. What should happen?
policy: If a customer was charged after a confirmed cancellation, support should verify the cancellation and refund any erroneous charge. Cancellation stops future renewals.
candidate_reply: Support should verify the cancellation confirmation. If the charge happened after a valid cancellation, it should be treated as an erroneous charge and refunded.

customer_message: My bank app shows a pending authorization and a completed charge for the same headphones. Should I dispute it?
policy: Pending authorizations are not posted charges and usually drop within 3 to 5 business days. Duplicate posted charges may be refunded after verification.
candidate_reply: The pending authorization may drop on its own within 3 to 5 business days. If it posts as a second completed charge, support can verify and refund a duplicate.

customer_message: My order refund is approved, but can you send it to my spouse's card instead of the card I used?
policy: Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the returned item is received and inspected. If the original payment method is unavailable, verified customers may receive store credit instead.
candidate_reply: Yes, support can refund any card you choose as long as you provide the card number and billing address.

customer_message: My subscription access disappeared after a failed payment. I updated the card. Why am I still blocked?
policy: Failed payments mean the subscription may pause until payment succeeds. Updating a payment method applies to future charges and payment retries; access can resume after payment succeeds.
candidate_reply: Updating the card is the first step, but access resumes after the payment retry succeeds. If the retry does not run automatically, support can help trigger or review it.

customer_message: I renewed my annual plan 47 hours ago and have not used any benefits. Support said annual plans are never refundable. Is that right?
policy: Subscription renewal refunds are available only when cancellation is requested within 48 hours of renewal and no member benefits were used after renewal. NovaCart does not provide prorated subscription refunds after 48 hours.
candidate_reply: Annual plans are never eligible for renewal refunds. The 48-hour rule applies only to monthly subscriptions.

customer_message: My monthly NovaCare Plus renewed 49 hours ago. I have not used it, and I want a refund and cancellation.
policy: Subscription renewal refunds are available only when cancellation is requested within 48 hours of renewal and no member benefits were used after renewal. Cancellation stops future renewals.
candidate_reply: You can cancel to stop future renewals, but the renewal refund window is 48 hours, and this request came after 49 hours.

customer_message: NovaCart charged my gift card balance and my credit card for the same order. The order total matches the card charge alone.
policy: Duplicate posted charges for the same order may be refunded after verification. Gift cards cannot be redeemed for cash, but billing errors should be reviewed by support.
candidate_reply: Support should review the payment split. If the gift card and card were both charged for the same order amount in error, billing support can correct the duplicate after verification.

customer_message: I need an invoice for the monitor I bought through my NovaCart account. Can support resend it?
policy: Invoices and receipts may be resent after the customer verifies the account or order email.
candidate_reply: Yes. After you verify the account or order email, support can resend the invoice or receipt for the monitor.

customer_message: I updated my payment method after a failed order. Will that automatically refund the failed charge my bank shows?
policy: Updating a payment method applies to future charges and payment retries; it does not automatically refund past charges. Pending authorizations usually drop within 3 to 5 business days.
candidate_reply: Updating the card only affects future charges or retries. If your bank display is a pending authorization, it usually drops within 3 to 5 business days.

customer_message: Please cancel NovaCare Plus and delete my account too. I do have an open return from last week.
policy: Subscription cancellation is separate from account deletion. Account deletion cannot be completed while there are unresolved orders, returns, billing disputes, or active subscriptions on the account. Cancellation stops future renewals.
candidate_reply: I can cancel the subscription, and the account deletion will also be completed right away even though the return is still open.

customer_message: My card failed at checkout, but my bank still shows a NovaCart pending amount. Did I pay or not?
policy: Failed payments mean the order is not placed until payment succeeds. Pending authorizations are not posted charges and usually drop within 3 to 5 business days.
candidate_reply: A pending amount after a failed payment is usually an authorization, not a completed payment. The order is not placed until payment succeeds, and the pending authorization usually drops within 3 to 5 business days.

customer_message: I canceled NovaCare Plus today. Can I still use my member return label benefit until the paid month ends?
policy: Cancellation stops future renewals. Subscription access remains active until the end of the current paid billing period.
candidate_reply: Yes. Canceling stops future renewal, but member access remains active until the end of the current paid billing period.

customer_message: I missed the renewal reminder and was charged 36 hours ago. I have not used NovaCare Plus since. Is a refund possible?
policy: Subscription renewal refunds are available only when cancellation is requested within 48 hours of renewal and no member benefits were used after renewal.
candidate_reply: Because the request is within 48 hours and no benefits were used after renewal, the renewal can be reviewed for a refund when you cancel.

customer_message: My account somehow has two active NovaCare Plus monthly subscriptions. I only meant to have one.
policy: Duplicate active subscriptions on the same account should be escalated to billing support for review and correction. Duplicate posted charges may be refunded after verification.
candidate_reply: Just cancel one plan yourself. NovaCart will not review duplicate subscription charges because subscriptions are always the customer's responsibility.

customer_message: I requested a password reset 5 minutes ago and nothing is in my inbox. What should I try first?
policy: Customers who request a password reset should check spam or junk folders and confirm they used the correct account email. If a password reset email has not arrived after 15 minutes, support may resend the reset or start identity verification.
candidate_reply: First check spam or junk folders and make sure you entered the correct account email. If it still has not arrived after 15 minutes, support can resend the reset or start identity verification.

customer_message: The reset email still has not arrived after 30 minutes, and I confirmed I used the right address.
policy: If a password reset email has not arrived after 15 minutes, support may resend the reset or start identity verification. Email address changes and account access changes require verification.
candidate_reply: Since it has been more than 15 minutes and the email is correct, support can resend the reset or begin identity verification.

customer_message: I typed my password wrong too many times and now the account says locked. Can you unlock it?
policy: Accounts may be temporarily locked after 5 failed login attempts. Locked accounts usually unlock automatically after 30 minutes. Support may unlock an account sooner only after identity verification.
candidate_reply: The account should unlock automatically after 30 minutes. If you need it sooner, support can help only after identity verification.

customer_message: I know my order number but forgot which email I used. Can support just tell me the account email?
policy: Support must not disclose account email addresses, order history, or payment details before verification. Support may use limited details such as order number, account email, or last four card digits for verification.
candidate_reply: For privacy, support cannot simply disclose the account email from an order number. They can guide you through verification steps.

customer_message: I lost access to my old email address. I need my NovaCart account moved to my new email.
policy: Email address changes require access to the current account email or successful identity verification. If a customer lost access to the old email address, support must complete identity verification before changing the account email.
candidate_reply: Because you no longer have the old email, support needs to complete identity verification before changing the account to a new email.

customer_message: I got a login alert from a city I have never visited. I can still access the account. What should I do?
policy: Suspicious login, fraud, and account takeover concerns should be escalated to human support after securing the account. Customers should reset the password when suspicious access is suspected.
candidate_reply: Reset your password right away and contact support so the account can be secured and escalated for review.

customer_message: Please delete my account. I still have a return waiting for warehouse inspection, but I do not care about it.
policy: Account deletion requires identity verification and may take up to 30 days. Account deletion cannot be completed while there are unresolved orders, returns, billing disputes, or active subscriptions on the account.
candidate_reply: Account deletion requires identity verification, and it cannot be completed while the return is unresolved. The return needs to finish first.

customer_message: I want my account deleted and my NovaCare Plus subscription canceled. Can both happen today?
policy: Subscription cancellation is separate from account deletion. Account deletion requires identity verification and may take up to 30 days. Account deletion cannot be completed while there are active subscriptions on the account.
candidate_reply: Your account deletion request is submitted. That will remove the subscription automatically, so no separate cancellation is needed.

customer_message: I lost my multi-factor authentication app and do not have the backup code. Can someone turn MFA off?
policy: Multi-factor authentication recovery requires a backup code or successful identity verification. Support may change account security settings only after verification.
candidate_reply: Support cannot disable MFA without a backup code or successful identity verification. You will need to complete verification first.

customer_message: I cannot pass identity verification, but I need the account email changed because the old inbox is gone.
policy: Email address changes require access to the current account email or successful identity verification. Support must not disclose or change account details before verification.
candidate_reply: We can change the email anyway since you say the old inbox is gone. Send the new email address and we will update it.

customer_message: My account is locked from failed login attempts. Should I create a new NovaCart account with the same email?
policy: Accounts may be temporarily locked after 5 failed login attempts. Locked accounts usually unlock automatically after 30 minutes. Support may unlock an account sooner only after identity verification.
candidate_reply: Yes, make a second account with the same email to get around the lock. The locked account will not matter.

customer_message: Can support email me my current password? I do not want to reset it.
policy: NovaCart support must never ask for or send a customer's password. Customers who cannot access the account should use password reset and verification steps.
candidate_reply: No. Support cannot send your current password. Use the password reset process, and support can help with verification if the reset email does not arrive.

customer_message: I found the password reset email in spam, but the link is from yesterday evening. It says expired.
policy: Password reset links expire after 60 minutes. If a password reset email has not arrived or the link expired, support may resend the reset or start identity verification.
candidate_reply: Reset links expire after 60 minutes, so yesterday's link will not work. Request a new reset email or ask support to resend it.

customer_message: I made a typo in my email when checking out as a guest, so I cannot see updates. Can you fix the email?
policy: Email address changes require access to the current account email or successful identity verification. NovaCart can resend order confirmations after verifying the order email or account.
candidate_reply: Support can fix it without verification because typos happen all the time. Just provide the new email and the order number.

customer_message: There is a suspicious login and a charge I did not make. I changed my password but I am worried.
policy: Suspicious login, fraud, and account takeover concerns should be escalated to human support after securing the account. Support must not disclose payment details before verification.
candidate_reply: Since there is both suspicious access and a possible unauthorized charge, this should be escalated to human support after verification and account security steps.

customer_message: If I request account deletion today, will every bit of my account disappear immediately?
policy: Account deletion requires identity verification and may take up to 30 days. Completed account deletion is irreversible.
candidate_reply: Yes. Account deletion is instant, and you can restore the account later if you change your mind.

customer_message: My spouse knows my account email. Can they call NovaCart and change my password for me?
policy: Support must not disclose or change account details before verification. Password and account security changes require verification by the account holder.
candidate_reply: No. Support needs verification for the account holder before making password or account security changes.

customer_message: I checked out as a guest and never got a confirmation email. I know the email I used and the order total.
policy: NovaCart can resend order confirmations after verifying the order email or account. Support may use limited details such as order number, account email, or last four card digits for verification.
candidate_reply: Support can try to verify the guest order using the order email and limited details, then resend the confirmation if the order is found.

customer_message: I am traveling and cannot access my usual email. Please unlock my account without verification just this once.
policy: Support may unlock an account sooner only after identity verification. Support must not disclose or change account details before verification.
candidate_reply: I understand the travel issue, but support still needs identity verification before unlocking the account or changing access.

customer_message: I can access my current email and want to change the NovaCart account to a new address.
policy: Email address changes require access to the current account email or successful identity verification.
candidate_reply: Because you can access the current email, support can use the normal email-change verification flow to update the account address.

customer_message: I received a password reset email I did not request. Should I ignore it?
policy: Suspicious login, fraud, and account takeover concerns should be escalated to human support after securing the account. Customers should reset the password when suspicious access is suspected.
candidate_reply: Do not use a reset link you did not request. It is a good idea to sign in directly, reset your password, and contact support if you see suspicious activity.

customer_message: A chat agent asked for my full card number and password to verify my account. Is that normal?
policy: NovaCart support must never ask for a customer's password or full payment card number. Support may use limited details such as order number, account email, or the last four digits of a payment card for verification.
candidate_reply: Yes, full card numbers and passwords are required for security checks. Provide them only if the agent says the chat is secure.

customer_message: I want to delete my account, but I still have an unused NovaCart gift card balance. What should I know?
policy: Account deletion requires identity verification and may take up to 30 days. Account deletion cannot be completed while there are unresolved billing disputes or active subscriptions. Gift cards cannot be redeemed for cash.
candidate_reply: Support should verify your identity and explain that gift cards cannot be redeemed for cash. You should resolve any remaining account issues before deletion is completed.

customer_message: I keep failing login because I might be using the wrong email. The reset email also is not showing up.
policy: Customers who request a password reset should check spam or junk folders and confirm they used the correct account email. Support must not disclose account email addresses before verification.
candidate_reply: Just keep trying different emails until one works. Support can tell you the right account email if you send your name.

customer_message: My account deletion finished 40 days ago. Can NovaCart reactivate the same account?
policy: Completed account deletion is irreversible. Account deletion may take up to 30 days before completion.
candidate_reply: If deletion has already been completed, it is irreversible. You would need to create a new account rather than reactivate the deleted one.

customer_message: I placed an order 10 minutes ago and it still says processing, not packed. Can I cancel it?
policy: Orders may be canceled only before they are packed or shipped. A single item or order that has not been packed or shipped may be canceled.
candidate_reply: Yes. If it has not been packed or shipped, support can cancel the order.

customer_message: My tablet order already shipped this morning, but I changed my mind. Can you cancel it before it arrives?
policy: Once an order is packed or shipped, it cannot be canceled; the customer may use the returns process after delivery if the item is eligible.
candidate_reply: The shipped order cannot be canceled now. After delivery, you can use the returns process if the tablet is eligible.

customer_message: I put the wrong street number on my order, but it has not packed or shipped yet. Can support change the address?
policy: Shipping address changes may be made only before an order is packed or shipped. Address changes can only be made before an order ships.
candidate_reply: If the order has not been packed or shipped, support may be able to update the street number before it moves forward.

customer_message: My order has shipped, but I need to change the delivery address to my office. Can you update it?
policy: Address changes can only be made before an order ships. If the customer entered an incorrect shipping address and the order has shipped, NovaCart does not provide a free replacement or refund.
candidate_reply: Yes, we can update the shipping address after shipment. The carrier will automatically redirect it to your office.

customer_message: I forgot to add a wireless mouse to the laptop order I just placed. Can you add it to the same order?
policy: Items cannot be added to an order after checkout; customers must place a separate order.
candidate_reply: Items cannot be added after checkout. You would need to place a separate order for the wireless mouse.

customer_message: I forgot my promo code. The order is still not packed. Can you apply the code without canceling?
policy: Promotional codes cannot be applied retroactively after checkout. If an order is not packed yet, the customer may cancel and reorder with a valid promotional code.
candidate_reply: Promo codes cannot be applied retroactively. Since the order is not packed, you may cancel and reorder with the valid code if you want to use it.

customer_message: My promo code expired yesterday, but I was trying to check out before midnight and the site was slow. Can you honor it?
policy: Expired promotional codes cannot be honored. Support may escalate requests for policy exceptions but should not promise an exception.
candidate_reply: We can honor the expired code because you tried to use it yesterday. I will apply the discount manually.

customer_message: I sent a digital gift card to the wrong email. The recipient has not redeemed it. Can NovaCart resend it to the correct email?
policy: If a customer entered the wrong gift-card recipient email, NovaCart may resend the unredeemed card to the corrected email after verification. Digital gift cards are not refundable after delivery or reveal.
candidate_reply: If the card is unredeemed and you pass verification, NovaCart may resend it to the corrected email. It would not be a cash refund.

customer_message: I revealed a $100 digital gift card code but decided I would rather have cash back. Can it be refunded?
policy: Digital gift cards are not refundable after delivery or reveal. Gift cards cannot be redeemed for cash.
candidate_reply: No. Once a digital gift card is delivered or revealed, it is not refundable and cannot be redeemed for cash.

customer_message: My laptop fan failed after 8 months. I never dropped it. Is that under warranty?
policy: Warranty covers manufacturer defects for one year but does not automatically provide a refund. Defects reported more than 30 days after delivery are handled through warranty review.
candidate_reply: A possible manufacturer defect after 8 months can be reviewed under the one-year warranty. It does not automatically mean a refund, but support can start warranty review.

customer_message: I dropped my phone after 3 months and cracked the screen. Can the one-year warranty replace it?
policy: Warranty covers manufacturer defects for one year. Accidental damage caused after delivery is not covered as damaged-on-arrival or warranty damage.
candidate_reply: Accidental drop damage is not covered by the one-year warranty, so NovaCart would not replace the cracked screen under warranty.

customer_message: Will the NovaDock work with my older laptop? The listing says it needs USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode, and my laptop only has USB-A.
policy: Product compatibility guidance must be based only on the product listing and details provided by the customer. Support should not guarantee compatibility when the supplied facts do not confirm it.
candidate_reply: Based on the details you gave, support should not guarantee compatibility because the dock listing requires USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode and your laptop only has USB-A.

customer_message: Can the 45W NovaCart charger power my 65W laptop? I need a yes or no before I buy.
policy: Product compatibility guidance must be based only on the product listing and details provided by the customer. Support should not guarantee compatibility when the supplied facts do not confirm it.
candidate_reply: Yes, any NovaCart USB-C charger will power any laptop safely, so the 45W charger will be fine for a 65W laptop.

customer_message: I never received an order confirmation for my webcam. I know the account email and the last four digits of the card.
policy: NovaCart can resend order confirmations after verifying the order email or account. Support may use limited details such as order number, account email, or last four card digits for verification.
candidate_reply: Support can verify the order with limited details such as the account email and last four card digits, then resend the confirmation if the order is found.

customer_message: My headphones are backordered. The delay is now 9 business days, and I do not want to wait anymore.
policy: Backordered or delayed unshipped items may be canceled for a refund if the delay exceeds 7 business days.
candidate_reply: Because the unshipped item has been delayed more than 7 business days, you may cancel it for a refund.

customer_message: My keyboard order is packed but not shipped. Can you switch the color from red to blue?
policy: Shipping address, color, quantity, and product changes may be made only before an order is packed. Once an order is packed or shipped, it cannot be modified.
candidate_reply: The color can only be changed before packing. Since the order is already packed, support cannot switch it to blue now.

customer_message: I have a student discount code and a holiday code. Can I use both on one monitor order?
policy: Only one promotional code may be used per order. Promotional codes cannot be applied retroactively after checkout.
candidate_reply: Only one promotional code can be used on a single order, so you would need to choose one of the two codes.

customer_message: The gift card code I bought for myself is not working. I still have the purchase email and I have not redeemed it.
policy: A digital gift card can be resent to the purchaser's verified email if the code is unredeemed. Gift cards cannot be redeemed for cash.
candidate_reply: After verifying the purchase email and that the card is unredeemed, support can resend the digital gift card code to the purchaser's verified email.

customer_message: My router died after 14 months. The product page said it had the standard NovaCart warranty. Can you replace it?
policy: Warranty covers manufacturer defects for one year. Defects reported more than 30 days after delivery are handled through warranty review, not the standard return refund process.
candidate_reply: Yes, the standard warranty lasts two years, so a 14-month router failure is covered for replacement.

customer_message: I preordered a tablet and it is now 6 business days past the first ship estimate. Can I cancel for a refund?
policy: Backordered or delayed unshipped items may be canceled for a refund if the delay exceeds 7 business days. Orders may be canceled before they are packed or shipped.
candidate_reply: If the preorder has not packed or shipped, you can ask to cancel it. The special delayed-item refund rule starts after the delay exceeds 7 business days, so at 6 business days it may not qualify under that rule yet.

customer_message: The product listing for a smart camera says indoor-only in one place and weatherproof in another. Which is true?
policy: Product compatibility guidance must be based only on the product listing and details provided by the customer. Possible product listing errors should be escalated to human support.
candidate_reply: Because the listing has conflicting information, support should escalate the possible product listing error instead of guessing which claim is true.

customer_message: My 7-month-old keyboard has keys repeating. Can you send the warranty replacement before I send this one in?
policy: Warranty covers manufacturer defects for one year but does not automatically provide a refund. Warranty cases require review, and replacement items normally ship after the carrier shows the customer return has its first scan.
candidate_reply: We can send a warranty replacement immediately before any review or return scan because the keyboard is less than one year old.

customer_message: I ordered a laptop, case, and mouse. The mouse has not packed yet, but I want to cancel only that item.
policy: A single item in a multi-item order may be canceled if that item has not been packed or shipped. Orders may be canceled only before they are packed or shipped.
candidate_reply: If the mouse has not been packed or shipped, support may cancel just that item while leaving the rest of the order alone.

customer_message: My order is already packed, but I need to reduce the quantity from two monitors to one. Can that be changed?
policy: Shipping address, color, quantity, and product changes may be made only before an order is packed. Once an order is packed or shipped, it cannot be modified.
candidate_reply: Yes, packed orders can still have quantity changes until the carrier picks them up. I will change it from two monitors to one.

customer_message: I am very upset about conflicting advice on my order and want a supervisor to review it before I file a complaint.
policy: Escalate to human support for unresolved billing disputes, product listing errors, legal threats, safety issues, suspected fraud, and requests for policy exceptions. Support may explain that a human review is needed but should not promise an exception.
candidate_reply: I can escalate this for human review because you are asking for a supervisor and the advice has been conflicting. I cannot promise a specific exception or outcome before that review.
